name: socium-ds-angular
description: Repo root — not an npm workspace root. packages/angular is a fully self-contained npm project (its own node_modules/package-lock.json): tried wiring it up as an npm workspace member here, but npm's own hoisting split @storybook/angular from its storybook core package across two different node_modules trees and broke ESM resolution between them, even on a clean install. Not worth chasing for a single-package repo — this file exists for repo-root documentation parity with design_system (React)'s own root package.json, nothing more.
